description:
Outcome: Reproduce all first-version outcomes on the agreed deployment, from BRIEF.md.
Scope: Separate-client add/take/finish and automatic board updates, concurrency, lost-response retries, restart/retention per T-002, access/privacy boundaries, failure recovery and startup documentation. Excludes: SMS.
Acceptance: All brief outcomes and T-002 decisions are demonstrated, including automatic refresh, safe concurrent claims and persistence behaviour as agreed.
Behaviour: Exercise empty/invalid states, simultaneous actions, disconnect/reconnect and delayed board responses.
Verification: Automated end-to-end evidence plus documented manual demonstration against acceptance criteria. Prerequisites: T-005, T-006, T-007 and T-010 (which includes T-009 transitively). Assumptions: follow T-002; no invented performance targets.
title: Verify the complete first version and deployment readiness
